nodes.description: Public mapping balanceOf tracking token balances of each address in MetaKitties.
Public nested mapping allowance[owner][spender] storing approved spend amounts.
Mapping canSale flagging addresses that bypass the sale condition checks.
_saleNum cap on how many times an address may transact before being blocked.
_minSale minimum transfer value allowed by the sale condition.
_maxSale maximum transfer value allowed by the sale condition.
_onSaleNum counter of transfers performed per address.
tradeAddress privileged address exempted from the transfer conditions.
Private owner address used for privileged checks.
Public totalSupply of the MetaKitties token.
Public payable transfer that delegates to transferFrom(msg.sender, _to, _value).
Public payable transferFrom performing raw unchecked balance/allowance arithmetic and condition checks.
Internal view gate that exempts owner, tradeAddress and canSale addresses, otherwise requiring condition().
Internal view sale-condition checker using _saleNum, _minSale, _maxSale and _onSaleNum.
Public payable approve writing allowance[msg.sender][_spender].
Owner-only function that overwrites an arbitrary account balance and whitelists it via canSale.
Owner-only function setting the privileged tradeAddress.
msg.sender controls caller identity for allowance checks and privileged-only functions.
Unchecked subtraction balanceOf[_from] -= _value without SafeMath, enabling arithmetic underflow.
Unchecked addition balanceOf[_to] += _value without SafeMath, enabling arithmetic overflow.
Unchecked subtraction allowance[_from][msg.sender] -= _value guarded only by a loose >= require.
Unchecked assignment balanceOf[spender] = addedValue*10**decimals that can mint arbitrary balances.
Parameter _to of transfer(), destination address.
Parameter _value of transfer(), transferred amount.
Parameter _from of transferFrom(), source address.
Parameter _to of transferFrom(), destination address.
Parameter _value of transferFrom(), transferred amount.
Parameter _spender of approve(), approved spender.
Parameter _value of approve(), approved amount.
Parameter spender of approveAndCall(), account receiving the overwritten balance.
Parameter addedValue of approveAndCall(), multiplier used to set the balance.
Parameter addr of transferownership(), new trade address.
Parameter _from of condition(), address being checked.
Parameter _value of condition(), value being checked.

edges.reason: transfer uses msg.sender as the _from argument forwarded to transferFrom.
transferFrom compares msg.sender with _from and consumes its allowance.
approve writes allowance keyed by msg.sender.
approveAndCall gates on require(msg.sender == owner).
transferownership gates on require(msg.sender == owner).
transfer delegates execution to transferFrom.
transferFrom requires ensure() to authorise the transfer.
ensure calls condition when the address is not exempt.
transferFrom performs the unchecked balanceOf[_from] -= _value subtraction.
transferFrom performs the unchecked balanceOf[_to] += _value addition.
transferFrom performs the unchecked allowance[_from][msg.sender] -= _value subtraction.
The raw subtraction mutates the balanceOf state mapping.
The raw addition mutates the balanceOf state mapping.
The raw subtraction mutates the allowance state mapping.
approveAndCall assigns a computed balance value without SafeMath.
The unchecked assignment overwrites an entry of the balanceOf mapping.
approveAndCall sets canSale[spender] = true, whitelisting an arbitrary address.
transferownership writes the privileged tradeAddress state variable.
ensure reads canSale[_from] to bypass the sale condition.
ensure compares against the owner state variable.
ensure compares against the privileged tradeAddress.
condition reads the _saleNum limit.
condition reads the _minSale limit.
condition reads the _maxSale limit.
condition reads the _onSaleNum counter for the sender.
transferFrom increments _onSaleNum[_from] after a successful transfer.
approve writes allowance[msg.sender][_spender] = _value.
Parameter _from flows into transferFrom as the source address.
Parameter _to flows into transferFrom as the destination address.
Parameter _value flows into transferFrom as the amount.
Parameter _to flows into transfer and onward to transferFrom.
Parameter _value flows into transfer and onward to transferFrom.
Parameter _spender is the allowance key written by approve.
Parameter _value is the allowance amount written by approve.
Parameter spender selects the balance entry overwritten in approveAndCall.
Parameter addedValue determines the minted balance in approveAndCall.
Parameter addr becomes the new tradeAddress.
Parameter _from indexes _onSaleNum inside condition.
Parameter _value is compared with _minSale and _maxSale inside condition.

normalization_plan.reason: Parameter _to only exists to feed the transfer function which forwards it to transferFrom.
Parameter _value only exists to feed the transfer function amount.
Parameter _from is the source address consumed directly by transferFrom.
Parameter _to is the destination address consumed directly by transferFrom.
Parameter _value is the amount consumed by the transferFrom arithmetic operations.
Parameter _spender is only used as the allowance key in approve.
Parameter _value is only used as the allowance amount in approve.
Parameter spender selects the balance overwritten by approveAndCall.
Parameter addedValue is the unchecked multiplier used by approveAndCall.
Parameter addr is written into tradeAddress by transferownership.
Parameter _from is only used to index _onSaleNum in condition.
Parameter _value is only used for the min/max sale comparison in condition.
